```{r afstanden secties}

sectie_afst <-
  tibble(sectie = 1:6,
```

```{r tabellen SI per km}

Data_larvaal_SI_gem <- 
  read_delim(paste0("../resultaten/tabellen/fint_larvaal_SI", nevengeul, ".csv"), delim = ";")

Data_adult_SI_gem <-
  read_delim(paste0("../resultaten/tabellen/fint_adult_SI", nevengeul, ".csv"), delim = ";")

```


```{r tabellen delta SI per km}

Data_larvaal_verschil_gem <-
  read_delim(paste0("../resultaten/tabellen/fint_larvaal_delta_SI", nevengeul, ".csv"), delim = ";")

Data_adult_verschil_gem <-
  read_delim(paste0("../resultaten/tabellen/fint_adult_delta_SI", nevengeul, ".csv"), delim = ";")

```


```{r SI}

data_SI <-
  Data_larvaal_SI_gem %>% 
  select(alternative, scenario, afst, SI_min = Score_min, SI_mean = Score) %>% 
  mutate(stage = "larval") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("SI_"),
               names_to = "type_score",
               values_to = "SI") %>% 
  bind_rows(Data_adult_SI_gem %>% 
              select(alternative, scenario, afst, SI_min = Score_min, SI_mean = Score) %>% 
              mutate(stage = "adult") %>% 
              pivot_longer(cols = contains("SI_"),
                           names_to = "type_score",
                           values_to = "SI")) %>% 
  mutate(sectie = map_int(afst, ~which(. < (sectie_afst$eind_afst+1))[1]),
         sectie = ifelse(is.na(sectie), 7, sectie)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(sectie))

data_SI_mean <-
  data_SI %>% 
  group_by(alternative, scenario, stage, sectie, type_score) %>% 
  summarise(across(SI, .fns = list(mean = mean, geom = ~exp(mean(log(.)))))) %>% 
  ungroup()


data_SI_mean %>% 
  ggplot(aes(SI_mean, SI_geom)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = type_score))


myPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlGn"))

data_SI_mean %>% 
  filter(scenario == "A0CN") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("SI_"),
               names_to = "type_mean",
               values_to = "SI") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ordered(sectie), alternative)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = SI)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(name = "SI",
                       # colours = rev(myPalette(100)), 
                       colours = myPalette(100), 
                       limits = c(0,1)) +
  facet_grid(type_score + type_mean ~ stage)

```


```{r trans functies}

# transform function
lal_trans_transform <- 
  function(tr, pw) {
    function(x) case_when (
      x <= -tr ~ -(abs(x)^(1/pw)),
      x >= tr ~ x^(1/pw),
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  }

# inverse transform
lal_trans_inverse <- 
  function(tr, pw) {
    function(x) case_when (
      x <= -(abs(-tr)^(1/pw)) ~ -(abs(x)^(pw)),
      x >= tr^(1/pw) ~ x^pw,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  }

```


```{r delta SI}

data_delta_SI <-
  Data_larvaal_verschil_gem %>% 
  select(alternative, scenario, afst, delta_min, delta_mean) %>% 
  mutate(stage = "larval") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("delta_"),
               names_to = "type_score",
               values_to = "delta_SI") %>% 
  bind_rows(Data_adult_verschil_gem %>% 
              select(alternative, scenario, afst, delta_min, delta_mean) %>% 
              mutate(stage = "adult") %>% 
              pivot_longer(cols = contains("delta_"),
                           names_to = "type_score",
                           values_to = "delta_SI")) %>% 
  mutate(sectie = map_int(afst, ~which(. < (sectie_afst$eind_afst+1))[1]),
         sectie = ifelse(is.na(sectie), 7, sectie)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(sectie))

data_delta_SI_mean <-
  data_delta_SI %>% 
  group_by(alternative, scenario, stage, sectie, type_score) %>% 
  summarise(across(delta_SI, ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(alternative = factor(alternative, levels = alternatives),
         stage = factor(stage, levels = c("larval", "adult")))


myPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))

tr <- 0.01
pw <- 1.5
lal_thresh_trans <- 
  function() scales::trans_new("lal_thresh", 
                               lal_trans_transform(tr, pw), lal_trans_inverse(tr, pw))

clrs <- 100
lims <- c(-1.01,1.01)
tr2 <-
  round(clrs/2*lal_trans_transform(tr, pw)(tr)/lal_trans_transform(tr, pw)(max(abs(lims), na.rm = TRUE)))

data_delta_SI_mean %>% 
  filter(scenario == "A0CN") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ordered(sectie), alternative)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = delta_SI)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(name = expression(paste(Delta, "SI")),
                       # colours = myPalette(100),
                       colours = c(myPalette(clrs)[1:(round(clrs/2)-tr2)],
                                   rep("white", 2*tr2), myPalette(clrs)[(round(clrs/2)+1+tr2):clrs]),
                       na.value = "grey85",
                       trans = "lal_thresh",
                       breaks = c(-1,-0.5,-0.2,-0.05,0.05,0.2,0.5,1),
                       limits = lims) +
  facet_grid(type_score ~ stage)

data_delta_SI_mean %>% 
  filter(scenario == "A0CN",
         type_score == "delta_min",
         stage == "larval") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ordered(sectie), alternative)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = delta_SI)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(name = expression(paste(Delta, "SI")),
                       # colours = myPalette(100),
                       colours = c(myPalette(clrs)[1:(round(clrs/2)-tr2)],
                                   rep("white", 2*tr2), myPalette(clrs)[(round(clrs/2)+1+tr2):clrs]),
                       na.value = "grey85",
                       trans = "lal_thresh",
                       breaks = c(-1,-0.5,-0.2,-0.05,0.05,0.2,0.5,1),
                       limits = lims) +
  facet_wrap( ~ stage, ncol = 1)

data_delta_SI_mean %>% 
  filter(scenario == "A0CN",
         type_score == "delta_min",
         stage == "adult") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ordered(sectie), alternative)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = delta_SI)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(name = expression(paste(Delta, "SI")),
                       # colours = myPalette(100),
                       colours = c(myPalette(clrs)[1:(round(clrs/2)-tr2)],
                                   rep("white", 2*tr2), myPalette(clrs)[(round(clrs/2)+1+tr2):clrs]),
                       na.value = "grey85",
                       trans = "lal_thresh",
                       breaks = c(-1,-0.5,-0.2,-0.05,0.05,0.2,0.5,1),
                       limits = lims) +
  facet_wrap( ~ stage, ncol = 1)


for (scen in unique(data_delta_SI_mean$scenario)) {
  for (stg in unique(data_delta_SI_mean$stage)) {
    data_delta_SI_mean %>% 
      filter(scenario == scen,
             type_score == "delta_min",
             stage == stg) %>% 
      select(-scenario, -stage, -type_score) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = alternative,
                  values_from = delta_SI) %>% 
      write_xlsx(str_c("../resultaten/tabellen/sectie/delta_SI_sectie_", stg, "_", scen, ".xlsx"))
  }
}

```
